description: Systems the project has been validated against. Anything else requires an explicit opt-in.

profiles.notes: Primary target: Toshiba Satellite Pro C850-1ER, Intel HD 4000, 1366x768.

policy.notes: A newer point release with the same GNOME major can be used with --allow-untested after reviewing reports/COMPATIBILITY_REPORT.md. A different GNOME major is refused unless --force-unsupported is passed.
